promises.quote: In terms of AUM, we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth
guiding for 145 to 160 bps next year, full year.

reported.quote: In Q4, AUM grew by 22.4% and PAT grew by 26.7%.
In Q4, AUM grew by 22.4% and PAT grew by 26.7%.
It's a proud moment for us as a company to end the quarter at approximately INR 510,000 crores.
